approvalScope: mobile OTP entry, autofill and verification
provider cancel, denial, unavailable, offline and retry recovery
Screen 02 and Screen 03 connected acceptance checkpoint

requiredState: anonymous return route is preserved when present

states.rule: The provider owns its native or secure browser approval surface. MoolSocial never reproduces provider credentials or consent in HTML or Flutter.

states.validation: Normalize and validate the selected target before requesting a code.

states.mobileAutofill: Use OS one-time-code autofill APIs; never read the SMS inbox silently.

states.action: Merge anonymous setup into the authenticated account and open Universal immediately without an intermediate MoolSocial success screen.

providerRules.youtube: Use Google basic identity only. Request YouTube channel scopes later and only from creator tools with feature-specific consent.
providerRules.instagram: Show only when the production provider configuration, policy, scopes, country and device are supported; otherwise expose a truthful recoverable unavailable state in review/testing and omit the dead action from a released provider configuration.
providerRules.externalSurface: Google, YouTube/Google, Apple, X, Instagram and Facebook account chooser or approval screens are provider-controlled.
security: no raw credentials logged or collected by MoolSocial UI

routing.authenticatedExit: /app/social unless a valid captured /app/ return route exists
routing.lifecycleRule: Process death, background/resume, call interruption, provider cancel and cold relaunch must resolve from durable setup/auth state without returning to Screen 01 mid-journey or skipping an incomplete verification.

prohibited: mixing the legacy SignInScreen or VerifyOtpScreen into UI V2
role or business onboarding before Universal
requesting YouTube channel-management scopes at login
fake provider success in a production build
internal planning, implementation, review or test language in customer-visible copy
dropping the Screen 02 area during authentication
